title: Frame property for a contract
statement: Let $C$ be a contract and, for each data value $i$, starting configuration $d$, and work tape $j$, specify a set $F_{i,d,j}$ of cell positions. The contract has the frame property for these sets if every eligible run ends in a configuration whose work tapes agree with those of its starting configuration at every position outside the corresponding set.
hypotheses_covered: A specified set of integer positions for each data value, starting configuration, and work tape
